# Sample photos

Test pictures of the smart photos end-to-end tests, scaled down to 800 px by
`make-samples.py`, which also wrote the dates and GPS positions in their EXIF
data (made up for the tests). All come from Wikimedia Commons:

| File | Original | Author | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| obama-portrait.jpg | [President Barack Obama.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Barack_Obama.jpg) | Pete Souza, The White House | Public domain (work of the U.S. federal government) |
| obama-desk.jpg | [Barack Obama thinking, first day in the Oval Office.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama_thinking,_first_day_in_the_Oval_Office.jpg) | Pete Souza, The White House | Public domain (work of the U.S. federal government) |
| obama-office.jpg | [Barack Obama Day 1 in the Oval Office.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama_Day_1_in_the_Oval_Office.jpg) | Pete Souza, The White House | Public domain (work of the U.S. federal government) |
| obama-biden.jpg | [Barack Obama and Joe Biden in the Oval Office - 2015.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama_and_Joe_Biden_in_the_Oval_Office_-_2015.jpg) | Pete Souza, The White House | Public domain (work of the U.S. federal government) |
| biden-portrait.jpg | [Joe Biden presidential portrait.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Joe_Biden_presidential_portrait.jpg) | Adam Schultz, The White House | Public domain (work of the U.S. federal government) |
| biden-2013.jpg | [Joe Biden official portrait 2013 cropped.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Joe_Biden_official_portrait_2013_cropped.jpg) | David Lienemann, The White House | Public domain (work of the U.S. federal government) |
| dog.jpg | [Golden-retriever-dog-1362597631o6g.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Golden-retriever-dog-1362597631o6g.jpg) | publicdomainpictures.net | CC0 1.0 |
| beach.jpg | [A magnificent white sand beach on Guam (line378129763).jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:A_magnificent_white_sand_beach_on_Guam_(line378129763).jpg) | NOAA Photo Library | Public domain (work of the U.S. federal government) |
